prevItem.title: Native Works Napalm 250
prevItem.excerpt:
The world famous Napalm diving popper from Native Works but in a very rare size!
Handmade in Japan, very small production.

They are very easy to move, very easy to dive and do a big difference when a pencil can not be used.
Intense bubble trail and motion.
Swims in any sea conditions.

DONT MISS OUT of these amazing diving poppers! Proven catcher on many fishes all around the globe.

100% handmade in Japan by Mr Kawauchi Kenichi, his lures are exceptional and undoubtly unique.

  • Length 250 mm

  • Gr. 155

Triangle structure of specially development.
